snippet.title: Catz: Your Computer Petz
snippet.description: Catz is a virtual pet and desktop companion game done by PF Magic in 1996. It is the second game in the Petz series. You have to take care of a little kitten, which doesn't mind sharing its desktop with you. It enjoys to be petted and you can play with it or watch it stalk the mouse across your documents. The Petz series also features Dogz, which is about little puppies, and Oddballz, with alien-like critters.
